recruiting.title: We're Hiring Developers 👨‍💻
recruiting.p1: While the Student Council runs POPO, PoApper builds and maintains it. 💪
recruiting.p2: The POPO team believes campus data at POSTECH is underused.
recruiting.p3: We also feel platforms for collecting POSTECH data are lacking.
recruiting.p4: We build platforms, accumulate data, and turn ideas into reality through active development and collaboration! 🤩
recruiting.p5: Build and grow that platform with us! 😎 Our door is always open 🔑
recruiting.li1: Build the website yourself and experience front-end and back-end!
recruiting.li2: Grow with mentorship from senior POPO developers!
recruiting.li3: Discover possibilities in POSTECH data collected via POPO!
recruiting.contactLead: Contact Us: Lead Developer, Taeyang Na (CSE '24)
